title: ProducerCommission - Data API
description: Represents a producer's commission for an insurance policy. The commission can be calculated from the commissionable transactions or can be populated from an external system. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

CommissionableAmount.description: The amount on which the commission is applied. This can be a transaction amount or a portion of the premium.

CommissionAmount.description: The calculated commission amount for the insurance policy transaction.

CommissionScheduleId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CommissionScheduleId.description: The ID of the associated Commission Schedule, which is the commission calculation tied to the product or producer. This is a relationship field.

InsurancePolicyAssetId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InsurancePolicyAssetId.description: The insured item for which the commission was calculated. This is a relationship field.

InsurancePolicyCoverageId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InsurancePolicyCoverageId.description: The ID of the policy coverage for which the commission was calculated. This is a relationship field.

InsurancePolicyId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InsurancePolicyId.description: The insurance policy for which the commission was calculated. This is a relationship field.

InsurancePolicyTransactionId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InsurancePolicyTransactionId.description: The transaction for which the commission record was created. This is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

MaxCommissionAmount.description: The maximum commission calculated for the product or producer for a commissionable event. Constrains the output from the commission schedule.

MinCommissionAmount.description: The minimum commission calculated for the product or producer for a commissionable event. Constrains the output from the commission schedule.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the producer commission.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the record owner. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentProducerCommissionId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentProducerCommissionId.description: The original commission record that was adjusted or modified. This is a relationship field.

PaymentDatetime.description: The date on which the commission was paid.

ProcessingProducerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProcessingProducerId.description: The producer who performed the commissionable event. This is a relationship field.

ProducerId.description: The producer, broker, brokerage, or other user who receives the commission. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProducerProductionCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProducerProductionCode.description: The production code for the producer who performs the commissionable event.

SourceSystem.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceSystem.description: The system from which the producer commission record was sourced.

SourceSystemIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceSystemIdentifier.description: The ID of the producer commission record in the source system. This field is unique within your organization.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Status.description: Specifies the status of the commission payment. Possible values are: Disputed Paid Pending Reversed

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Type.description: Specifies the type of commission paid to a producer, account, or contact for a commissionable transaction. Possible values are: Advance Bonus Chargeback Commission Contingent Commission
